svg.title: Integration Hub — animated system architecture
svg.desc: React and FastAPI lead to LangGraph investigation, retrieval, verification, bounded reflection, human approval and local ticket creation. Services: Chroma, Ollama Qwen2.5, nomic embeddings, SQLite, reviewed memory and traces. Cloud integrations are optional and disabled. Native deployment is local; Docker runtime remains unverified.
svg.text: From incident logs to an evidence-backed recovery plan.
Durable state · bounded reflection · approval gate
No API charge in local mode
OPTIONAL CLOUD ADAPTERS / DISABLED BY DEFAULT
Keenable search · ElevenLabs voice · explicit memory / trace exports
Consent + credentials + budget required; live cloud operation unverified.
Docker Compose / Nginx prepared; runtime unverified.
Cited hypothesis → human decision → local recovery plan
Illustrative motion · no automatic production remediation
